Clay and resin are made in white. You can colour the ring after it is made in 3D.
Band shape: you are looking through the ring. What you draw shapes the band\'s outline (gold in the picture). Put any stone on top.
Top & stone: you are looking down at the top of the ring. What you draw shapes the stone and whatever sits on top.
Side profile: you are looking at the ring from the side. What you draw shapes how thick the band is and how high the stone sits.
Your ring will be shared in the Gallery under this name, so others can try it on too.
• Making it 3D takes one to two minutes. It has already started.
• Ring shape view gives the best 3D. Draw the whole band and put the stone on top.
• SketchOn sizes the ring to your finger and turns it so the stone faces up.
Making your ring in 3D while you name it… %1$d s
Pick a colour for your ring. Turn it to see every side.
Colouring the band and the decoration separately: coming soon.
Pick a colour, then touch the ring with your index fingertip to paint where you touch.

Hold the right trigger and touch the ring to paint. Touch a colour, the eraser or a brush size on the left controller\'s palette with the brush tip to choose it. Put the controllers down before you wear the ring.
Squeeze the right grip near the ring and move to carry it.
Pinch the dot under the ring and drag it to move the ring.
Drag the ring itself to turn it, or use the buttons.
Log in to draw rings and share them. Anyone can browse the Gallery. New here? Choose a name and a password of 6 or more characters, then Sign up.
Draw with controllers or your hands. To wear a ring, put the controllers down: the headset only sees your hands once the controllers are set aside.
When it is ready you will wear it on your hand. Put the controllers down now so the headset can see your hands.
Put the controllers down: the ring needs your bare hand.
